subject: Exec approval request: BlueMarsh Labs hosted API concession
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request: BlueMarsh Labs hosted API concession

Team —

Quick background: BlueMarsh Labs (platform + imaging vendor) is ready to commit to a 36‑month hosted API contract with an aggressive usage ramp forecast (projected 3.2B tokens Q3–Q4). Procurement needs a pricing deck and exec authorization by the end of next week to hit their fiscal close.

Why this matters: they are a strategic channel partner for our healthcare vertical roadmap (multi‑region deployment + co‑sell motion). They are currently evaluating two incumbents; winning this will likely unlock introductions to two enterprise customers inside their network.

Request: Sales is asking for a 27% off list Hosted API unit price concession for the first 12 months (then reverts to standard volume tier). They will sign a 3yr committed spend and prepay the first 6 months if approved.

Impact: at our blended cost this is beyond standard dealdesk thresholds (>20% requires exec approval). Estimated margin impact: ~12% hit to hosted token margin in year 1, recouped in years 2–3 by committed volume.

Attachments: bluemarsh_deal_summary.pdf (deal summary + projected usage), bluemarsh_usage_projection_q3q4.csv

Ask: Mina / Marcus — can you review and, if comfortable, provide exec sign‑off this week? Ben and I can join for a 15m call to walk details.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555‑0198
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: BlueMarsh Labs hosted API concession

On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 09:05 AM Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick background: BlueMarsh Labs ...

Connor — I support this ask. BlueMarsh is moving very fast on contract and the competitive threat if we stall is real. A few quick notes:
- Legal has pre‑cleared the standard Hosted API T&Cs; no unusual IP carveouts requested.
- Procurement pushed back on ramp timing unless we give a deeper first‑year concession.

If it helps, we could structure as: 27% off list for first 12 months tied to a 3yr contract with a minimal quarterly volume commitment and a 6‑month prepay. That preserves cancellation protections and makes the math defensible to finance.

I also attached a one‑page revised pricing that shows ARR impact. Happy to jump on a 15m call.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Exec approval request: BlueMarsh Labs hosted API concession

Marcus / Stephanie — forwarding the BlueMarsh summary and Connor's note. TL;DR: request is for a 27% first‑year concession on Hosted API pricing in exchange for a 36‑month commitment and a 6‑month prepay.

Why I recommend approval:
- High strategic value (channel + healthcare referrals).
- Clean legal footprint; no bespoke data residency asks beyond our Private offering note.
- Committed volume profile materially improves utilization across our US cluster strategy (helps Dedicated planning).

Controls I want attached if you approve: a minimum quarterly token commit, prepay to cover first two quarters, automatic reversion to standard pricing after month 12, and a clause to re‑evaluate pricing on material usage >150% of forecast.

Evidence attached: bluemarsh_deal_summary.pdf, bluemarsh_usage_projection_q3q4.csv

Please advise — they are asking for final pricing by EOD next Friday (30 Apr).

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
VP, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: BlueMarsh Labs hosted API concession

I have reviewed the materials and spoke with Finance. I approve a one‑time 27% Hosted API unit price concession for BlueMarsh Labs subject to the following conditions:

1) Signed 36‑month MSA with a minimum quarterly token commit (details in HubSpot record).
2) Prepayment covering first two quarters (non‑refundable toward token usage).
3) Pricing reverts to standard volume tier after month 12 unless usage exceeds forecasted threshold (then pricing table to be re‑negotiated).
4) Deal to be recorded in Deal Desk with explicit margin impact and reporting cadence to Finance (monthly token reconciliation).
5) Legal to include an audit clause for usage and an acceptance test for early deployment.

I authorize Connor/Ben to finalize the commercial terms and send the pro forma and DocuSign link. Please copy me on the signature email.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
SVP, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Laura Hayes <laura.hayes@bluemarshlabs.com>, procurement@bluemarshlabs.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: BlueMarsh Labs hosted API concession

Laura / BlueMarsh procurement — good news: Redwood leadership has granted exec approval for the commercial structure we discussed. Summary below: 

- Concession: 27% off list Hosted API unit price for months 1–12
- Commitment: 36‑month MSA with minimum quarterly token commits
- Prepay: customer to prepay first two quarters (credited to token usage)
- Reversion: pricing will revert to standard volume tier after month 12 unless usage materially exceeds forecast

Next steps: I will send the pro forma invoice and DocuSign envelope by EOD today. Please review procurement and legal with your team; DocuSign link will include the commercial exhibit and the volume commit schedule.

Attachment: proforma-invoice-bluemarsh.pdf
DocuSign (expected): https://www.docusign.com/en/launch?envelopeId=ABC123-BlueMarsh

Thanks — excited to get this over the line.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
